title: Predictive Enrichment of KAHM Soft-State Abstractions: Information Retention and Decoder Access
scope: Direct observed-response prediction; no autonomous transition fit or closure validation.
generator: unchanged kahm_dev.data.base_episodes; new stream allocation only
secondary_selection: shared cap selected by A__local__linear on B

data_roles.C: fixed-model diagnostics; score only after complete D prediction seal
data_roles.D: terminal evaluation; generated only after all A/B selections sealed

inference.interval: two-sided paired Student intervals with Bonferroni adjustment
inference.threshold: candidate-reference interval wholly below/above zero; otherwise unresolved
inference.zero_variance: report point mean; no Student inference; retain original family size

precision.scope: multiplier of future paired SD, not absolute precision or power assurance

numerics.unexpected_failure: stop; no candidate/task deletion or substitute seed
numerics.solver: unchanged Step 4 NumPy-first, checked SciPy gesvd on LinAlgError
numerics.query_guard: unchanged Step 4 affine fallback with recomputed complete score
numerics.rank_zero: explicit common center fallback; not a successful positive-rank PCA
numerics.independent_audit: Cholesky ridge refits; on factor failure or tolerance disagreement, verify identical ridge objective by augmented QR (gelsy); record each use; stop if QR also disagrees. Forecast and coefficient tolerances unchanged.

source_policy.data_protection: procedural ordering and hashes, not cryptographic target isolation

seed_generation: SHA256(namespace|law|rep|split|purpose); first 16 big-endian bytes for data/rows; first 4 for fit; PCG64 via default_rng
failure_policy: No primary inferential release unless all 256 tasks and all 52 selected records per task are finite, complete and verified.
